stops.stop: Fifth Avenue, New York: the arrival
stops.date_confidence: attested to 20 September 1928. Total distance and stage count are contested: 21,500 km in 504 stages, or about 17,000 km in 494 stages, depending on the source. The widely reprinted interval of three years, four months and six days is an inherited arithmetic error; from 24 April 1925 the elapsed time is three years and 149 days
